title: Cell dissociation from airway biopsies with cold-active protease for single-cell RNA-seq
author: Laure-Emmanuelle Zaragosi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x3efqje
materials: Count with Countess automated cell counter using both sides of chambers. Monitor the percentage of nucleated cells (Hoechst +) and dead cells (GFP+). (Thermo Fisher Scientific, AMQAF1000, Countess™ II FL Automated Cell Counter with Dapi and GFP cubes) Countess GFP image after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Countess Dapi image after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Countess report after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Countess report after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining Floid image after NucGreen and Hoescht33342 staining

steps.title: Collect bronchial biopsy
steps.instruction: Perform a bronchial biopsy at the desired airway level using Medi‑Globe forceps (GBF‑21‑18‑120) under medical supervision.

steps.title: Prepare dissociation buffer
steps.instruction: Make fresh ice‑cold dissociation buffer (1 mL total): 850 µL PBS, 100 µL protease stock (100 mg/mL from Bacillus licheniformis, final 10 mg/mL), and 50 µL 10 mM EDTA (final 0.5 mM). Keep on ice.

steps.title: Transfer biopsy to buffer
steps.instruction: Place the biopsy in 1 mL DPBS in a well of a 6‑well plate, observe its appearance, then transfer it with a wide‑bore 1 mL pipette tip into 1 mL ice‑cold dissociation buffer in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Mince tissue in buffer
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑bore tip, move the biopsy to a 100 mm petri dish, take as little buffer as possible, and mince the tissue with a scalpel equipped with a #10 blade into the smallest possible pieces. Transfer the minced pieces back to the dissociation buffer with a small volume of buffer and rinse the dish with additional buffer to recover cells.

steps.title: Incubate with trituration
steps.instruction: Incubate the minced tissue on ice for 90–120 min. Every 5 min, gently triturate the suspension five times using needles of decreasing size (21 G → 23 G).

steps.title: Inactivate protease
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of inactivation buffer (HBSS containing 2 % BSA) to the suspension. Prepare inactivation buffer by mixing 40 mL HBSS with 10 mL 10 % BSA stock (final 2 % BSA).

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. Carefully discard the supernatant, leaving ~10 µL residual liquid on the pellet.

steps.title: Assess RBC content
steps.instruction: Add Hoechst 33342 to an aliquot of the cell suspension, examine under an inverted microscope or use an automated cell counter (e.g., Countess) to determine the proportion of red blood cells.

steps.title: RBC lysis (if needed)
steps.instruction: If RBCs constitute ≥50 % of the cells, perform lysis as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL of 0.8 % ammonium chloride solution (STEMCELL Technologies catalog #7800) to 100 µL cell suspension (9 : 1 volume ratio).
Spin at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL wash buffer (HBSS + 1 % BSA; prepare by mixing 20 mL HBSS with 20 mL 2 % BSA stock).
Spin at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend in another 100 µL wash buffer and examine under the microscope to confirm successful lysis.
Add 1 mL wash buffer, spin 400 g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, leave ~10 µL.
Resuspend in 500 µL wash buffer, spin 400 g 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, leave ~10 µL.
Finally, resuspend the pellet in 40 µL resuspension buffer (HBSS + 0.05 % BSA; prepare by mixing 39 mL HBSS with 1 mL 2 % BSA stock).

steps.title: Skip lysis (low RBC)
steps.instruction: If RBC content is <50 %, proceed directly to the final resuspension step: resuspend the pellet in 40 µL resuspension buffer (HBSS + 0.05 % BSA).

steps.title: Stain and count cells
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of the cell suspension with 10 µL cell‑counting solution (HBSS containing 20 µg/mL Hoechst 33342 and NucGreen). Prepare counting solution by combining 500 µL HBSS, 1 µL Hoechst 33342 (10 mg/mL, Thermo Fisher #H3570), and 1 drop NucGreen™ Dead 488 ReadyProbes™ (Thermo Fisher #R37109). Incubate 1 min at room temperature and assess cell concentration.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the stained cell suspension through a Flowmi cell strainer (catalog #H13680‑0040).

steps.title: Add wash buffer post‑filter
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL wash buffer (HBSS + 1 % BSA) to the filtered cells and mix gently.

steps.title: Store or transport sample
steps.instruction: If the sample must be stored or transported, keep the tube on ice or in a polystyrene box with ice packs. Biopsies may remain in dissociation buffer for up to 60 min.

steps.title: Adjust final cell concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute or concentrate the cell suspension with wash buffer to achieve 700–1000 cells/µL, the optimal range for the 10X Chromium platform. Verify the final concentration before loading.
